latest_cos_commentary.headline: Slang.ai is a well-funded ($68M total, including a $36M Series B in February 2026) voice-AI call-answering platform for full-service restaurants, running in 2,000+ locations, focused on reservations and FAQ handling rather than phone ordering.
latest_cos_commentary.genius_exposure: Overlaps with Genius's loyalty_engagement/guest-communication surfaces on inbound call handling, not POS or payments; by its own positioning it deflects ordering calls to online ordering rather than competing on order-taking or payment capture.
latest_cos_commentary.competitive_timing: Recently raised a large Series B (Feb 2026) specifically to scale guest-communications AI across more restaurants, indicating well-capitalized, active expansion in the voice-AI category.
latest_cos_commentary.sales_response: Distinguish Slang.ai (call answering/reservations, deflects to online ordering) from phone-ordering competitors like Revmo AI when discussing voice-AI category positioning with a prospect; it is not a payments or POS competitor.
latest_cos_commentary.risk_and_uncertainty: Scope claims (2,000+ locations, 25M calls) are company-reported; independent verification was not available in this pass.
